newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela aluminum output to grow 5.4 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela aluminum output to grow 5.4 pct in 1996.

text.p: Primary aluminum production from Venezuela's state-owned smelters Alcasa and Venalum is seen totaling 663,644 tonnes in 1996, up 5.4 percent from 629,827 tonnes in 1995, according to official figures obtained by Reuters.

Of the total production Alcasa will account for 214,916 tonnes, up from 201,589 tonnes in 1995 and Venalum will account for 448,728 tonnes, up from 428,238 tonnes last year, according to a table of results for companies in state holding Corporacion Venezolana de Guayana (CVG).
Of the total output, Alcasa is seen selling 211,912 tonnes and Venalum 424,900 tonnes, the table showed.
The table did not break down how much of production was exported.
Alcasa and Venalum are due to be privatized on Jan 31 as part of an aluminum sector sell-off.

Thirteen companies have qualified to bid for the four-company aluminum sector including Aluminum Company of America (Alcoa), Gencor Ltd, Glencore Ltd, Reynolds Metals Co, Norsk Hydro ASA, and RTZ Corp-Cra Ltd.
